key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll kubectl for node status.

key.name: notify-node-changes
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a node becomes NotReady or recovers.

key.name: notify-cluster-unreachable
key.summary: Notify when the cluster is unreachable
key.description: Show a notification when kubectl can't reach the cluster for longer than the debounce window.

key.name: notify-on-recovery
key.description: Also notify when a node comes back or the cluster becomes reachable again.

key.name: alert-node-for
key.description: A node must stay NotReady this long before it notifies. Rides out brief blips.

key.name: alert-cluster-for
key.description: The cluster must stay unreachable this long before it notifies.

key.name: alert-keep-firing-for
key.description: Hold a firing alert this long after its condition clears, so a flapping node or a one-poll blip doesn't resolve and re-fire.

key.name: alert-repeat-interval
key.description: Re-notify about a still-firing alert this often. Zero never repeats.

key.name: alert-group-wait
key.description: Batch alerts that fire within this window into one banner. Zero coalesces only those from the same poll.

key.name: alert-silence-until
key.description: Internal: notifications are muted until this Unix time in milliseconds. Set from the panel menu's snooze control; 0 means not muted.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Write why each poll and alert decision was made to the system journal, for troubleshooting. Off by default: logged messages are shared with every other application's logs. Credential material is redacted, and raw kubectl output is never logged.

key.name: alert-state
key.description: Internal: the serialized alert state machine, so restarts don't replay or forget alerts. Not user-editable.

key.name: context
key.description: Context name. Empty means the current context is used.

key.name: kubeconfig-path
key.description: Path to the kubeconfig file. Empty means the default (~/.kube/config).

key.name: kubectl-path
key.description: Full path to the kubectl binary. Empty means look it up in PATH.
